title: teamagent stats --help canonical envelope
description: JSON Schema for the canonical envelope emitted by `pnpm teamagent stats --help`, used by the 1+2+3 hard-match feature-verification gate.

examples.summary: Show TeamAgent knowledge statistics: rule counts, layer distribution, and recent additions.

flags.name: --explain
flags.description: Provide a natural-language explanation of the stats output using the given context string.

flags.name: --explain-like-ceo-duck
flags.description: Re-render the stats output in duck-friendly CEO language (呷呷~ mode).

flags.name: --override-signals
flags.description: Ignore signal filters and show all rules regardless of active signal state.

flags.name: --stuck-in-promotion
flags.description: Include rules that are stuck in promotion and have not advanced to a higher tier.
